notes.title: [Ver.1.03] Update Information
notes.notes:
[Ver.1.03] Update Information

Chinese and Korean languages are now supported.
Experience coins can now be obtained even if the game ends before completion.
A UI hide button has been added to the bottom left corner of the screen when the game is completed or ends.
Background operation is now supported.
